title: post_copy
description: Output of 07_COVERS: the caption of the post (decision D-17, 2026-10-23). Contract proposal: docs/visual-layer/caption-cta-proposal.md section 4.1.

job_id.description: editorial.jobs.id; existence is checked by code

model.description: model name, or not_reported when the stage used no LLM

created_at.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, with the Z suffix

evidence_ids.description: each id must exist in verification and be VERIFIED; checked by code. Every claim of the caption needs evidence (CLAUDE.md sections 4 and 8)

caption.description: post text, written below the image on the platform; it is not on the art. Length in code points. Blank text, hashtags, mentions, blocklist and numbers are checked by code
